objective: Connect CAT-05 first-party confirmation to CAT-02 freshness so verified merchant confirmations become dated, recurring, measurable product-trust evidence without conflating research recency, factual confirmation, commercial rights or market proof.

proofLadder.name: Technical confirmation-to-freshness path
proofLadder.evidence: Main contains verified-operator weekly-hours confirmation path and CAT-02 contains dated freshness semantics.

proofLadder.name: First independent merchant confirmation
proofLadder.workingGate: At least one verified external business produces a genuine F1 weekly-hours confirmation through the product flow.

proofLadder.name: Initial multi-merchant coverage
proofLadder.workingGate: At least five independent external businesses have genuine current F1 confirmations; founder/related-party or synthetic rows do not count.

proofLadder.name: Recurring confirmation behavior
proofLadder.workingGate: At least three independent businesses complete a second genuine confirmation cycle after their first confirmation; same-session duplicates do not count.

proofLadder.name: Operational freshness discipline
proofLadder.workingGate: For 30 consecutive days, at least 80% of businesses inside the explicitly enrolled confirmation cohort keep their confirmation-governed critical facts within the applicable SLA, with no stale operator fact retaining NOW priority.

metricDefinitions.numerator: distinct enrolled external businesses with at least one current genuine F1 confirmation
metricDefinitions.denominator: distinct businesses in the explicitly enrolled confirmation cohort

metricDefinitions.numerator: confirmation-governed facts whose latest genuine confirmation timestamp is within the field-specific SLA
metricDefinitions.denominator: confirmation-governed facts expected for the enrolled cohort
metricDefinitions.notes: Missing facts remain missing/unknown; they are not silently counted as fresh.

metricDefinitions.numerator: independent businesses with a second genuine confirmation cycle
metricDefinitions.denominator: independent businesses whose first confirmation is old enough to be eligible for reconfirmation
metricDefinitions.notes: Same-session repeated writes and automated refreshes do not count as reconfirmation.
